definitions: controlled_entity_of: the provider is listed as an included entity in a Single modern slavery statement on the Modern Slavery Statements Register, that is, included in the group's statement as owned or controlled by the one reporting entity (group_key). Matched by the included entity's ABN, or by exact normalised name agreeing with both the ACECQA legal name and the ABR entity name. It is not a verified ownership chain, shareholding or date of acquisition. This is the only ownership edge in this layer.
group_parent_self: the provider is itself the one reporting entity of a Single statement that lists included entities. It marks the provider as a group head; it is not an edge to another provider.
co_reported_joint: the provider is named (as a reporting or included entity) in a Joint statement. Joint statements can combine unrelated bodies, so these rows are never edges.

It is not a verified ownership chain, shareholding or date of acquisition. This is the only ownership edge in this layer.
group_parent_self: the provider is itself the one reporting entity of a Single statement that lists included entities. It marks the provider as a group head; it is not an edge to another provider.
co_reported_joint: the provider is named (as a reporting or included entity) in a Joint statement. Joint statements can combine unrelated bodies, so these rows are never edges.
The register covers entities with annual consolidated revenue of at least AUD 100 million, plus voluntary reporters. Absence of an edge says nothing about ownership.
Name-matched edges are not verified by ABN or ACN; they need the ACECQA legal name and the ABR entity name to agree.
Each edge is collapsed to one row per provider and group from the latest statement; statement_ids lists every statement. A provider in an older statement may since have changed hands.
